warnings.title: Data-Training Tier Warning
warnings.message:
!!! CONTRIBUTOR TIER — TRAINS ON YOUR DATA !!!

This is Meta's contributor tier. Selecting it permits Meta to use your
prompts and completions to train future Meta models.

See current pricing and rate limits for the Meta Model API here:
  https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits/

It lowers the barrier to entry for prototyping, testing integrations, and
scaling experiments where training on your data is acceptable. Do NOT use it
for confidential, proprietary, personal, or otherwise sensitive data. For the
same model with no training on your data, select the standard variant
(without the -contributor suffix).

Confirm only if training on your prompts and completions is acceptable.

warnings.title: Large Context Switch Warning
warnings.message:
!!! LARGE CONTEXT MODEL SWITCH !!!

This session holds ~200,000 tokens of context.
Switching to muse-spark-1.2-contributor makes the next reply re-read all of it uncached (providers key prompt caches per model) — a one-time full-price input cost.

Threshold: model.switch_context_confirm_tokens (currently 100,000; 0 disables this check).
Confirm only if you intend to switch now.
